[Story]
In a noodle shop, chef Xiao Gang is preparing noodles of different flavors. He tells the waitress Xiao Li, "We offer 40 different flavors of noodles, most of which are meat noodles, some are seafood noodles, but there are almost no vegetarian noodles." Xiao Li checks the menu and finds that there are only 5 kinds of seafood noodles.

[Question]
After checking the menu, how many types of meat noodles does Xiao Li guess?

[Candidate Answers]
A. After checking the menu, Xiao Li guesses there are 25 types of meat noodles.
B. After checking the menu, Xiao Li guesses there are 33 types of meat noodles.
C. After checking the menu, Xiao Li guesses there are 35 types of meat noodles.
D. After checking the menu, Xiao Li guesses there are 20 types of meat noodles.
